title: Almost Unified
body: **Unify all resources.** ## Information This is a mod for [Minecraft]-[NeoForge] and [Fabric]. Big modpacks often end up with the same resource from several mods: five copper ingots that don't stack and recipes that only accept one of them. Almost Unified picks one target item per tag, based on a mod priority list, and makes recipes, loot and recipe viewers use it. Recipe inputs accept the whole tag, so items from other mods stay usable, also in existing worlds. It is made for modpack developers and adds no items, recipes or ore generation of its own. Immersive Engineering support comes from the separate add-on [AU: Immersive Engineering]. ## Features - recipe inputs are replaced with their tag and outputs with the target item - target items chosen by priority overrides, then the mod priority list - ore tags respect stone variants - duplicate recipes created by the unification are removed - optional loot unification - optional world generation unification (NeoForge) - tools and armor accept the target item for repairs - custom tags, tag substitutions, tag inheritance and placeholders like `{material}` in the config - multiple unification configs for different sets of tags - everything reloads with `/reload` - API for other mods to add their own recipe unifiers ## Integrations - [JEI]: hides the unified items and marks changed recipes - [REI]: hides the unified items and marks changed recipes - [EMI]: hides the unified items, with an optional strict mode, and marks changed recipes - [KubeJS]: binding to look up target items and tags in scripts ## Credits - inspired by [UniDict] by WanionCane - logo by mo_shark [minecraft]: https://www.minecraft.net/ [neoforge]: https://neoforged.net/ [fabric]: https://fabricmc.net/ [au: immersive engineering]: https://github.com/AlmostReliable/almostunified-ie [jei]: https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems [rei]: https://github.com/shedaniel/RoughlyEnoughItems [emi]: https://github.com/emilyploszaj/emi [kubejs]: https://kubejs.com/ [unidict]: https://github.com/WanionCane/UniDict
